protocol.persistence: same pack: temporary file, flush, fsync, atomic replace, archive digest
protocol.memory: encode/decode/range phases in separate fresh processes; RSS includes runtime and buffers
protocol.range_cache: OS cache warm; open_reader excludes manifest open; open_and_read includes open/close; no OS cache eviction
protocol.sampling: file probabilities proportional to raw bytes; separate small/large/cross-chunk groups

limits: OS warm cache; reopen is not a cold-disk measurement
RKV container controls only, not a claim against all seekable storage systems
